set.acceptance: go test -trimpath -p 2 ./internal/api -run 'TestShipOpenPR|TestReviewJournaled|TestReviewDeclared' and go test -trimpath -p 2 ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(ship-open-pr.*|run-ship-change)$' pass: with a fake gh and a real git remote, a first call pushes the branch and creates one PR titled by the change set with the summary's text as body, a second call after a new commit pushes and edits that PR's body without creating another, and rhiza ship check after it reads the recorded PR; a run whose workflow declares no review (no checks step, no workflow step running a review, no agent step with [[check]] tables; e.g. myteam-flow from docs/examples/byo/workflow.toml) opens the PR with no review journaled; (failure case) a call outside a run, or in a run whose workflow declares a review (ship-change, bugfix, ship-change-classic) with none journaled, exits non-zero naming why
set.files: internal/api/ship_openpr.go, internal/api/ship_openpr_test.go, internal/workflow/workflow.go (a declared-review test on the workflow's shape), internal/workflow/workflow_test.go, docs/reference (regenerated with rhiza docs if a description changes)
set.must_not: Decide by a workflow's or step's name; drop the guard for a workflow that declares a review; add a workflow file key
